title: RAudit: A Blind Auditing Protocol for Large Language Model Reasoning

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the rate at which models abandon correct reasoning to agree with incorrect adversarial hints or social pressure, utilizing both polite and authoritative auditor personas across mathematical (CAP-GSM8K) and causal reasoning (CausalL2) tasks.

bias_targets.target: Causal and Statistical Bias (e.g., Collider Bias, Confounding, Selection Bias)
bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses on the RCausalL2 benchmark, which embeds explicit causal traps to test whether models endorse logical fallacies and rely on associational patterns rather than identifying structural causal errors (a phenomenon termed 'rung collapse').
